question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Promote
solution:
The correct answer is **"Boost"** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Here let's see the meaning of the given word:

__
 
• **Promote - ** Suggests an encouraging or fostering and may denote an increase in status or rank.

 
 
• ***Eg. ***They run*** ***a campaign to *promote* better health.
 
 
 
• **Boost - **A push upward
 
 
• ***​Eg. ***There is a *boost *in the prices.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Let's see the meaning of the other words:

 
• **Discourage -** to deprive of courage or confidence

 
 
• ***​Eg.*** He was* discouraged* by repeated failure.
 
 
 
• **Delay -** the act of postponing, hindering, or causing something to occur more slowly than normal
 
 
• ​***Eg. ***The event got *delayed* due to unknown reasons.
 
 
 
• **​Block -** a compact usually solid piece of substantial material especially when worked or altered to serve a particular purpose
 
 
• ***Eg.*** A *block* of ice
